identity.lineage: Fair Share (FS-26-T7 · ccf27576) with its weeks laid out again on 4 Nov 2026, to the owner's question whether there could be a period where 14 days' leave buys 30 days off, Sundays made not available. exact-rota.py, on Fair Share's duties, was asked for 30 days off costing 14 days' leave, then to win back what that cost: the most weeks on one shift time, then the gentlest change of start, with four weeks off for 14 days' leave held as well. It was a search result with no name until the links where 14 days' leave buys 30 days off were given a folder of their own, the same day.
